hints.title: Common Ancestor Branch Point
hints.text: The shortest path goes up to the lowest common ancestor and then down to the destination node.

hints.title: Root Path Tracing
hints.text: Use depth-first search to record the directional sequence from the root to the start node and destination node.

hints.title: Path Reconciliation
hints.text: Remove the shared initial directions. Convert all remaining start steps to U and append the remaining destination steps.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import Optional

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

class Solution:
    def getDirections(self, root: Optional[TreeNode], startValue: int, destValue: int) -> str:
        def find_path(node: Optional[TreeNode], target: int, path: list[str]) -> bool:
            if not node:
                return False
            if node.val == target:
                return True
            path.append('L')
            if find_path(node.left, target, path):
                return True
            path.pop()

            path.append('R')
            if find_path(node.right, target, path):
                return True
            path.pop()

            return False

        start_path: list[str] = []
        dest_path: list[str] = []

        find_path(root, startValue, start_path)
        find_path(root, destValue, dest_path)

        i = 0
        min_len = min(len(start_path), len(dest_path))
        while i < min_len and start_path[i] == dest_path[i]:
            i += 1

        up_steps = 'U' * (len(start_path) - i)
        down_steps = ''.join(dest_path[i:])

        return up_steps + down_steps
```

complexity.time: O(N) tree path discovery and prefix matching
complexity.space: O(N) recursion stack and path strings
variables: N: number of nodes in binary tree
complexity.notes: Find root-to-start and root-to-dest paths, trim the common prefix (LCA), and replace upward steps with U.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph conversion and BFS uses more memory and incurs overhead compared to path comparisons from root.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Finding two paths from root replaces full graph construction with depth-first searches.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that trimming the common prefix reveals the branch point at the LCA.
